points.point: Why the carousel with a collaborator tagged fails
points.sentence: They are **not supported on carousels** (multi-image/video posts) - a carousel with collaborators will fail to publish.

points.point: Single photo posts with a collaborator work (is that normal)
points.sentence: Collaborators are supported on **single image posts and reels**.

points.point: What to do for the carousel
points.sentence: For a carousel, publish it first, then add the collaborator in the Instagram app.

verdict.reason: The entry states that collaborators are unsupported on carousels and cause the failure, that single image posts are supported, and what to do instead.
